text:
**Best overall for a Qi2 3-in-1 stand: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Wireless Charging Stand (Qi2 25W), $129.99**

Macworld's May 2026 review calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has tested. It delivers 25 W to an iPhone, fast-charges the Apple Watch, has a pad for AirPods, and includes a 45 W adapter. It's also heavier (399 g) and bulkier than travel-focused rivals. [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)

Macworld's review page doesn't include a direct buy link, so search for the Satechi model at your preferred retailer.

**Other strong picks**

- **Fastest for a fixed stand: Nomad Stand One Max, $169.** WIRED calls it the fastest-charging option it tested, at 25 W for the iPhone. It has a landscape-friendly pad and a nightstand-style Watch puck, but no power adapter is included, so you need a 40 W one. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Good 25 W option for the bedside: Nimble Podium 3-in-1, $130.** WIRED's best 3-in-1 pad charger. Its flat design keeps devices out of sight at night, and it includes a 36 W adapter. Apple Watch charging is slow, so leave it on overnight. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Fast and folds for travel: ESR CryoBoost, about $100.** WIRED's fastest travel 3-in-1, with 25 W charging, an active fan that can be switched off, and a 50 W adapter. The plastic build feels less premium. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)
- **Budget Qi2 option: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station, listed at $40 (sale).** WIRED's best cheap pick. The iPhone pad charges at 15 W, and the Watch charger is a separate unit. A newer 25 W version costs more. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Best Qi2 at 15 W: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand, $98 (sale).** WIRED's best overall pick in its wireless-stand guide. It's a classic stand with 15 W iPhone charging, Watch fast charging, and StandBy support. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Things to check before buying**

- **25 W needs a recent iPhone.** Per the ESR listing, 25 W applies only to the iPhone 17 series, iPhone 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus on iOS 26. Other models get 20 W or less. [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)
- **Your AirPods case must support wireless charging.** Non-wireless cases won't work on the AirPods pad. [Macworld MagSafe guide](https://www.macworld.com/article/668980/best-magsafe-chargers.html)
- **Prices are time-sensitive.** The WIRED pages were updated in September and June 2026, so confirm current prices.

**Deal and disclosure note:** Dealectric's ESR CryoBoost page lists a code, PARTNER18, which it says took $17.99 off at ESR's US store on Oct 23, 2026, bringing the $99.99 price to about $82. The store's checkout decides whether it applies. Dealectric earns a commission if you buy through its link, which it says pays for its testing. [Dealectric ESR CryoBoost](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand) · [Buy link](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)

**My pick:** For a permanent desk or nightstand stand with 25 W iPhone charging, go with the Satechi. If you travel often or want the lowest price for the same speed, the ESR CryoBoost is the better value.
